images.subject: A crystal mining complex, one towering multi-level industrial building built directly around the wide dark mouth of a mine tunnel cut into the cliff face, with one massive conveyor carrying raw crystal out of the tunnel.
images.detail: Huge clusters of pale blue crystal grow out of the exposed rock around the tunnel mouth.
images.state: Far-future high-tech mining machinery in active use, with composite panels and polished metal under a very light coat of rock dust, and bright floodlights switched on.
images.site: It is built into the foot of a towering dark neutral grey rock cliff heavily covered with thick white snow and ice, with the ground all around blanketed in deep white snow and snowdrifts, on a frozen lifeless alien planet of bare rock, ice and wind-blown snow.
